replication.target_description: Pavlović OSF project 74892, First impression replication study (Asch, 1945, Experiment 1): author-provided First_impression_output.pdf contains multiple separate trait-choice contingency tables and Fisher exact tests. Page 2 contains the preceding generous-trait test results and the beginning of the wise-trait table; the supplied locator does not identify one outcome/test.

notes: The original primary paper title was verified in frozen cache text. The replication project title was verified in cached ReadMe provenance and the public OSF file listing; First_impression_output.pdf was obtained directly from the author project. All 15 assigned input records have the same description and locators, with no specific secondary trait/outcome identifier. No mapping from audit_id or input order to trait rows was inferred. Both primary sources are accessible; locator_insufficient does not mean paper_unavailable. Original Table 2 prints trait-choice percentages, not odds ratios or inferential p values. Its nominal group sizes (90 warm, 76 cold) cannot be treated as the target analytic n: p. 263 explicitly states that occasional missing choices make the number of cases vary by trait. No original OR was reconstructed from those percentages or taken from the replication author's original-study reanalysis. Replication output prints multiple tests/alternatives, so no statistic or n was selected without an outcome identifier. The supplied project materials inspected do not provide an authors' narrative replication-success verdict for a uniquely identified target.
